title: Point-of-Care Ultrasound of Upper Airway Changes During Cardiopulmonary Bypass in Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: single-center, prospective, randomized, observer-blinded trial, 76 patients ... randomized 1:1 to a 0 cmH2O or 20-30 cmH2O ETT cuff pressure strategy ... POCUS measurements of lateral pharyngeal wall (LPW) thickness ... group x time interaction for LPW thickness was significant.
assessment_de: Zwei randomisierte Arme (Cuff-Deflation vs. 20-30 cmH2O); kontinuierlicher POCUS-Endpunkt. Einschluss I01 bestaetigt.

title: Chyme reinfusion using The Insides® System to reduce parenteral nutrition dependence in type 2 intestinal failure: multicentre randomized clinical trial (REINFUSE).
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: multicentre, open-label randomized clinical trial ... block randomized 2:1 to device-assisted CRT plus standard care (active) or standard care (control) ... primary endpoint was >=50% reduction in PN caloric intake at 30 days ... 8 of 26 active participants (31%) achieved the primary endpoint versus no controls.
assessment_de: Zwei randomisierte Arme (CRT vs. Standard); binaerer PN-Reduktions-Endpunkt mit Ereignissen pro Arm. Einschluss I01 bestaetigt.

title: Patient-reported barriers to dietary adherence in heart failure: a qualitative substudy of the Pro-HEART trial.
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: qualitative substudy of the registered Pro-HEART randomized controlled trial ... Twenty-four participants ... semi-structured interviews ... reflexive thematic analysis ... six key themes.
assessment_de: Qualitative Interviewstudie ohne quantitative Armwerte. Ausschluss X10 bestaetigt.

title: Evaluation of Candidate Urinary microRNAs in Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma: A Prospective Multicenter Biomarker Study (JCOG1403A1).
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: prospective multicenter ancillary study of the JCOG1403 trial ... 45 patients with UTUC and 16 healthy controls ... urinary miRNAs ... discrimination ... relapse-free survival.
assessment_de: Diagnostische Biomarker-Assoziationsstudie ohne randomisierten Interventionseffekt. Ausschluss X07 bestaetigt.

title: Adverse Experiences in Brief Meditation Practices: Randomized Controlled Trial.
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial ... 3 brief, digitally delivered meditation practices ... relative to using the internet as usual ... randomly assigned to meditation or control conditions.
assessment_de: Vier Bedingungen (drei Meditationen, Internetkontrolle); kein zulaessiger einzelner Zweiarm-Kontrast. Ausschluss X01 bestaetigt.

title: Effect of Semaglutide on Thigh Skeletal Muscle Volume, Fat Infiltration and Physical Function in People With Obesity: Secondary Analysis of STEP UP.
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: phase 3b STEP UP trial randomised adults ... to once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide 7.2 mg, semaglutide 2.4 mg or placebo ... semaglutide 7.2 mg, n = 43, 2.4 mg, n = 6 (pooled semaglutide group, n = 49); placebo, n = 6.
assessment_de: Drei randomisierte Arme; Dosen nur gepoolt verglichen. Ausschluss X01 bestaetigt.

title: Plasma Cluster of Differentiation 147 and Cognitive Impairment After Acute Ischemic Stroke.
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: preplanned ancillary study of CATIS ... 612 patients with ischemic stroke ... plasma CD147 levels ... PSCI ... elevated plasma CD147 levels were significantly associated with higher odds of PSCI.
assessment_de: Beobachtende Biomarker-Assoziation ohne randomisierten Armvergleich. Ausschluss X03 bestaetigt.

title: Impact of Left Internal Mammary Artery-to-Left Anterior Descending Artery Anastomotic Location on Graft Patency: A Secondary Analysis of the PATENCY Trial Data Set.
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: secondary analysis of the PATENCY trial data set ... 1597 patients ... relative anastomotic site ... distal anastomosis ... associated with a significantly lower 3-year LIMA occlusion rate.
assessment_de: Beobachtende Analyse der Anastomosenlage ohne randomisierten Armvergleich. Ausschluss X03 bestaetigt.
